units.zh: 梁書卷第十六 列傳第十
units.en: Book of Liang, Volume 16, Biographies 10
units.literal: Book of Liang, Volume 16, Biographies 10

units.zh: 王亮 張稷 王瑩
units.en: Wang Liang; Zhang Ji; Wang Ying
units.literal: Wang Liang; Zhang Ji; Wang Ying

units.zh: 王亮字奉叔，琅邪臨沂人，晉丞相導之六世孫也。
units.en: Wang Liang, styled Fengshu, came from Linyi in Langye—a sixth-generation descendant of Jin Chancellor Dao.
units.literal: Wang Liang, styled Fengshu, was a native of Linyi in Langye; he was sixth-generation descendant of Jin Chancellor Dao.

units.zh: 祖偃，宋右光祿大夫、開府儀同三司。
units.en: His grandfather Yan had been Song right grand master of splendid happiness, opening the government with ritual equal to the three excellencies.
units.literal: His grandfather Yan was Song Right Grand Master of Splendid Happiness, opening the government with ritual equal to the three excellencies.

units.zh: 父攸，給事黃門侍郎。
units.en: His father You was an attendant yellow gate gentleman.
units.literal: His father You was Attendant Yellow Gate Gentleman.

units.zh: 亮以名家子，宋末選尚公主，拜駙馬都尉、秘書郎，累遷桂陽王文學，南郡王友，秘書丞。
units.en: As a son of a great house, at the end of Song he was matched to a princess, made commandant of the horse for the imperial son-in-law and secretary gentleman, and rose through literary scholar to the prince of Guiyang, friend to the prince of Nanjun, and secretary assistant.
units.literal: Liang was a scion of a famous house; at the end of Song he was chosen to marry a princess, made Commandant of the Horse for the Imperial Son-in-law and Secretary Gentleman, and rose through Literary Scholar to the Prince of Guiyang, Friend to the Prince of Nanjun, and Secretary Assistant.

units.zh: 齊竟陵王子良開西邸，延才俊以爲士林館，使工圖畫其像，亮亦預焉。
units.en: When Qi's prince of Jingling opened the Western Lodge and gathered worthies for the Scholars' Grove Hall, artisans painted their likenesses—and Liang was among them.
units.literal: Qi Prince of Jingling Zi Liang opened the Western Lodge, gathering talented men for the Scholars' Grove Hall and having artisans paint their portraits—Liang was among them.

units.zh: 遷中書侍郎、大司馬從事中郎，出爲衡陽太守。
units.en: He rose to secretariat gentleman and chief staff officer to the grand marshal, then went out as Hengyang governor.
units.literal: He was promoted to Secretariat Gentleman and Chief Staff Officer to the Grand Marshal, and went out as Governor of Hengyang.

units.zh: 以南土卑濕，辭不之官，遷給事黃門侍郎。
units.en: The south was low and damp; he declined the post and was made attendant yellow gate gentleman.
units.literal: Because the southern land was low and humid, he declined the office and was transferred to Attendant Yellow Gate Gentleman.

units.zh: 尋拜晉陵太守，在職清公有美政。
units.en: Soon he was Jinling governor—pure in office, with a reputation for good rule.
units.literal: Soon he was appointed Governor of Jinling; in office he was pure and public-spirited, with fine governance.

units.zh: 時齊明帝作相，聞而嘉之，引爲領軍長史，甚見賞納。
units.en: Qi Emperor Ming was then regent; hearing of him he praised him, made him chief of staff to the guard general, and favored him deeply.
units.literal: At the time Qi Emperor Ming was acting as regent; hearing of this he praised him, brought him in as Chief Staff Officer to the Guard General, and greatly favored and received him.

units.zh: 及卽位，累遷太子中庶子，尚書吏部郎，詮序著稱，遷侍中。
units.en: When Ming took the throne, Liang rose to crown prince palace attendant and director of the ministry of personnel—his rankings won fame—and then to attendant.
units.literal: When Ming took the throne, he rose through offices to Crown Prince Palace Attendant and Director of the Ministry of Personnel—his evaluations won renown—and was promoted to Attendant.

units.zh: 建武末，爲吏部尚書，是時尚書右僕射江祏管朝政，多所進拔，爲士子所歸。
units.en: Late in Jianwu he headed the ministry of personnel; Right Vice Director Jiang Shi then ran court politics, advanced many men, and drew the gentry to him.
units.literal: At the end of Jianwu he was Director of the Ministry of Personnel; at the time Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Jiang Shi managed court politics, promoted many men, and was where scholars gathered.

units.zh: 亮自以身居選部，每持異議。
units.en: Liang, as head of selection, often took the other side.
units.literal: Liang, considering himself head of the selection bureau, often held opposing views.

units.zh: 始亮未爲吏部郎時，以祏帝之內弟，故深友祏，祏爲之延譽，益爲帝所器重；
units.en: Earlier, before Liang headed personnel, he had been close to Shi—the emperor's brother-in-law—and Shi had praised him, so the throne prized him all the more;
units.literal: At first, before Liang was Director of the Ministry of Personnel, because Shi was the emperor's brother-in-law he befriended him deeply; Shi spread his reputation, so the emperor valued him all the more;

units.zh: 至是與祏昵之如初。
units.en: yet now they were intimate as ever.
units.literal: but now they were as intimate as before.

units.zh: 及祏遇誅，羣小放命，凡所除拜，悉由內寵，亮更弗能止。
units.en: When Shi was killed, petty men had their way; every appointment ran through inner favorites, and Liang could not stop it.
units.literal: When Shi was executed, petty men ran wild—all appointments passed through inner favorites, and Liang could no longer stop them.

units.zh: 外若詳審，內無明鑒，其所選用，拘資次而已，當世不謂爲能。
units.en: Outwardly he seemed careful; inwardly he had no clear eye. He chose by seniority alone, and the age did not call him able.
units.literal: Outwardly he seemed careful in review, inwardly he lacked clear judgment; those he selected were bound by seniority alone—the age did not call him capable.

units.zh: 頻加通直散騎常侍、太子右衛率，爲尚書右僕射、中護軍。
units.en: He was repeatedly made regular attendant cavalier attendant-in-ordinary, right guard lieutenant to the crown prince, right vice director of the masters of writing, and central army commander.
units.literal: He was repeatedly made Regular Attendant Cavalier Attendant-in-Ordinary, Right Guard Lieutenant to the Crown Prince, Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, and Central Army Commander.

units.zh: 旣而東昏肆虐，淫刑已逞，亮傾側取容，竟以免戮。
units.en: Then Eastern Depravity raged and cruel punishments ran their course—Liang bent to please and barely escaped death.
units.literal: Then Eastern Depravity ran rampant and cruel punishments had their day—Liang leaned this way and that to please and escaped death by a hair.

units.zh: 義師至新林，內外百僚皆道迎，其未能拔者，亦間路送誠款，亮獨不遣。
units.en: When the Righteous Army reached Xinlin, officials within and without went out to welcome them; those who could not leave still sent loyalty by back roads—only Liang sent no one.
units.literal: When the Righteous Army reached Xinlin, officials inside and outside all went out to welcome them; those who could not break away still sent pledges of loyalty by side roads—only Liang sent no one.

units.zh: 及城內旣定，獨推亮爲首。
units.en: Once the city was settled, he alone was pushed forward as ringleader.
units.literal: When the city was settled, he alone was singled out as ringleader.

units.zh: 亮出見高祖，高祖曰：「顛而不扶，安用彼相。」
units.en: Liang came out to see Gaozu. Gaozu said, "When the tottering man is not held up, what use is that minister!"
units.literal: Liang came out to see Gaozu; Gaozu said: "When the toppling man is not supported, what use is that minister!"

units.zh: 而弗之罪也。
units.en: Yet he did not punish him.
units.literal: Yet he did not punish him.

units.zh: 霸府開，以爲大司馬長史、撫軍將軍、琅邪、清河二郡太守。
units.en: When the supreme office opened, he was made chief of staff to the grand marshal, pacifying army general, and governor of Langye and Qinghe.
units.literal: When the Supreme Office opened, he was made Chief Staff Officer to the Grand Marshal, Pacifying Army General, and Governor of both Langye and Qinghe commanderies.

units.zh: 梁臺建，授侍中、尚書令，固讓不拜，乃爲侍中、中書監，兼尚書令。
units.en: When the Liang regime was set up, he was offered attendant and director of the masters of writing; he refused firmly and was made attendant, director of the secretariat, with the masters of writing added.
units.literal: When the Liang regime was established, he was appointed Attendant and Director of the Masters of Writing; he firmly refused; he was then made Attendant, Director of the Secretariat, and concurrently Director of the Masters of Writing.

units.zh: 高祖受禪，遷侍中、尚書令、中軍將軍，引參佐命，封豫寧縣公，邑二千戶。
units.en: When Gaozu took the mandate, Liang became attendant, director of the masters of writing, and central army general, drawn into founding the state, and was enfeoffed duke of Yuning with two thousand households.
units.literal: When Gaozu received the abdication, he was promoted to Attendant, Director of the Masters of Writing, and Central Army General, drawn into assisting the mandate, and enfeoffed as Duke of Yuning with two thousand households.

units.zh: 天監二年，轉左光祿大夫，侍中、中軍如故。
units.en: In Tianjian's second year he was transferred to left grand master of splendid happiness; attendant and central army were unchanged.
units.literal: In the second year of Tianjian he was transferred to Left Grand Master of Splendid Happiness, Attendant and Central Army unchanged.

units.zh: 元日朝會萬國，亮辭疾不登殿，設饌別省，而語笑自若。
units.en: On New Year's Day the myriad states met in court; Liang pleaded illness, did not mount the hall, dined in a side office, and talked and laughed as if at ease.
units.literal: On New Year's Day the myriad states assembled in court; Liang pleaded illness and did not ascend the hall, set out food in a separate office, yet talked and laughed as if at ease.

units.zh: 數日，詔公卿問訊，亮無疾色，御史中丞樂藹奏大不敬，論棄市刑。
units.en: Days later an edict sent dukes and ministers to inquire; Liang showed no sickness; censor-in-chief Yue Ai memorialized gross disrespect and asked the death penalty in the marketplace.
units.literal: Several days later an edict had the dukes and ministers inquire; Liang showed no sign of illness; Censor-in-Chief Yue Ai memorialized for gross disrespect, penalty of execution in the marketplace.

units.zh: 詔削爵廢爲庶人。
units.en: An edict stripped his rank and made him a commoner.
units.literal: An edict stripped his rank and made him a commoner.

units.zh: 四年夏，高祖讌於華光殿，謂羣臣曰：「朕日昃聽政，思聞得失。
units.en: In summer of the fourth year Gaozu feasted at Huaguang Hall and told the ministers, "From noon I hear government, wishing to learn gain and loss.
units.literal: In summer of the fourth year Gaozu feasted at Huaguang Hall and said to the assembled ministers: "From noon I hear affairs of state, wishing to learn gain and loss.

units.zh: 卿等可謂多士，宜各盡獻替。」
units.en: You are many scholars—each should offer full and frank counsel."
units.literal: You may be called many scholars—each should fully offer candid counsel."

units.zh: 尚書左丞范縝起曰：「司徒謝朏本有虛名，陛下擢之如此，前尚書令王亮頗有治實，陛下棄之如彼，是愚臣所不知。」
units.en: Left assistant director Fan Zhen rose and said, "Grand Marshal Xie Fei had only empty fame, yet Your Majesty raised him so; former director Wang Liang had real governing merit, yet Your Majesty cast him off so—this dull minister cannot understand."
units.literal: Left Assistant Director of the Masters of Writing Fan Zhen rose and said: "Grand Marshal Xie Fei originally had only empty fame, yet Your Majesty raised him thus; former Director Wang Liang truly had governing merit, yet Your Majesty cast him off like that—this a dull minister cannot understand."

units.zh: 高祖變色曰：「卿可更餘言。」
units.en: Gaozu's color changed. "You may speak on other matters."
units.literal: Gaozu's face changed: "You may speak on other matters."

units.zh: 縝固執不已，高祖不悅。
units.en: Zhen pressed on; Gaozu was displeased.
units.literal: Zhen persisted without end; Gaozu was displeased.

units.zh: 御史中丞任昉因奏曰：
units.en: Censor-in-chief Ren Fang then memorialized:
units.literal: Censor-in-Chief Ren Fang then memorialized:

units.zh: 臣聞息夫歷詆，漢有正刑；
units.en: Your servant has heard that Xi Fu's successive slander drew right punishment in Han;
units.literal: Your servant has heard: Xi Fu's successive slander—Han had right punishment;

units.zh: 白褒一奏，晉以明罰。
units.en: Bai Bao's single memorial drew clear penalty in Jin.
units.literal: Bai Bao's one memorial—Jin applied clear penalty.

units.zh: 況乎附下訕上，毀譽自口者哉。
units.en: How much more those who fawn below and slander above, who praise and blame from their own mouths?
units.literal: How much more for those who fawn on inferiors and slander superiors, whose praise and blame issue from their own mouths?

units.zh: 風聞尚書左丞臣范縝，自晉安還，語人云：「我不詣餘人，惟詣王亮；
units.en: I have heard that left assistant director Fan Zhen, returning from Jin'an, said, "I visit no one but Wang Liang;
units.literal: I have heard that Left Assistant Director Fan Zhen, returning from Jin'an, told people: "I do not visit others, only Wang Liang;

units.zh: 不餉餘人，惟餉王亮。」
units.en: I give gifts to no one but Wang Liang."
units.literal: I do not give gifts to others, only Wang Liang."

units.zh: 輒收縝白從左右萬休到臺辨問，與風聞符同。
units.en: I at once arrested Zhen and had his attendant Wan Xiu questioned at the bureau; it matched the report.
units.literal: I at once arrested Zhen and had his attendant Wan Xiu brought to the bureau for questioning; it matched what was heard.

units.zh: 又今月十日，御餞梁州刺史臣珍國，宴私旣洽，羣臣並已謁退，時詔留侍中臣昂等十人，訪以政道。
units.en: Also on the tenth of this month, at the private farewell feast for your servant Zhen Guo, Inspector of Liang Province, when the feast ended and the ministers had withdrawn, an edict kept your servant Ang, Attendant-in-Ordinary, and ten others to ask about government.
units.literal: Also on the tenth of this month, at a private farewell feast for your servant Zhen Guo, Inspector of Liang Province, when the feast was done and the ministers had all withdrawn to pay respects, an edict retained your servant Ang, Attendant-in-Ordinary, and ten others to inquire into the way of government.

units.zh: 縝不答所問，而橫議沸騰，遂貶裁司徒臣朏，褒舉庶人王亮。
units.en: Zhen did not answer what was asked but poured out reckless talk, disparaging grand marshal Tiao and praising the commoner Wang Liang.
units.literal: Zhen did not answer what was asked but launched a torrent of reckless talk, disparaging Grand Marshal Tiao and praising the commoner Wang Liang.

units.zh: 臣于時預奉恩留，肩隨並立，耳目所接，差非風聞。
units.en: Your servant was then among those kept by grace, standing shoulder to shoulder—what eyes and ears took in was scarcely hearsay.
units.literal: Your servant at the time was among those retained by grace, shoulder to shoulder standing—what eyes and ears received differs little from hearsay.

units.zh: 竊尋王有遊豫，親御軒陛，義深推轂，情均《湛露》。
units.en: I reflect that when the king takes his pleasure, he mounts the steps in person—the meaning is deep in pushing the cart-wheel, the feeling equal to "Dew on the Fronds."
units.literal: I reflect that when the king has outings and pleasures, he personally mounts the steps; the meaning is deep in pushing the cart, the feeling equal to "Dew on the Fronds."

units.zh: 酒闌宴罷，當扆正立，記事在前，記言在後，軫早朝之念，深求瘼之情，而縝言不遜，妄陳褒貶，傷濟濟之風，缺側席之望。
units.en: When wine ended and the feast broke up, he should stand straight before the screen—records before, words after—mindful of the dawn audience, seeking the people's ills—yet Zhen spoke insolently and rashly praised and blamed, harming orderly custom and the hope of the vacant seat.
units.literal: When the wine was spent and the feast ended, he should stand upright before the screen—records before, words after—brooding on the dawn audience's cares, deeply seeking the people's afflictions—yet Zhen's words were insolent, rashly offering praise and blame, harming the orderly wind and lacking the hope of the vacant seat.

units.zh: 不有嚴裁，憲準將頹，縝卽主。
units.en: Without severe punishment the law's standard will fall—and Zhen is chief among the guilty.
units.literal: Without severe punishment, law's standard will collapse—Zhen is chief among this.

units.zh: 臣謹案：尚書左丞臣范縝，衣冠緒餘，言行舛駁，誇諧里落，喧詬周行。
units.en: Your servant respectfully finds that left assistant director Fan Zhen, of coat-and-cap lineage, is at odds in word and deed, boasts in his village, and clamors in the streets.
units.literal: Your servant respectfully finds: Left Assistant Director Fan Zhen, coat and cap from a fine line, conduct and words at odds, boasting in his village, clamor in the thoroughfares.

units.zh: 曲學諛聞，未知去代；
units.en: Curved learning and flattery—he does not know how to leave the age;
units.literal: Curved learning and flattery—he does not know how to leave the age;

units.zh: 弄口鳴舌，祇足飾非。
units.en: wagging tongue and clucking mouth—only enough to dress up error.
units.literal: wagging tongue and clucking mouth—only enough to deck out error.

units.zh: 乃者，義師近次，縝丁罹艱棘，曾不呼門，墨縗景附，頗同先覺，實奉龍顏。
units.en: When lately the Righteous Army drew near, Zhen suffered family calamity; he never called at the gate but in black hemp and mourning white shadowed the scene like foreknowledge—truly serving the dragon countenance.
units.literal: When lately the Righteous Army was near, Zhen suffered family calamity; he never called at the gate, but in black hemp and mourning white shadowed the scene, quite like foreknowledge—truly serving the dragon countenance.

units.zh: 而今黨協釁餘，飜爲矛楯，人而無恒，成茲姦詖。
units.en: Now he joins with the remnants of sedition and turns enemy—a man without constancy, accomplishing this treachery.
units.literal: Now he has joined with the remnants of sedition and turned enemy—man without constancy, accomplishing this treachery.

units.zh: 日者，飲至策勳，功微賞厚，出守名邦，入司管轄，苞篚罔遺，而假稱折轅，衣裙所弊，讒激失所，許與疵廢，廷辱民宗。
units.en: At the feast of merit, merit was slight yet reward thick—out as governor of a famous commandery, in as overseer of a department—gift baskets not forgotten, yet he falsely claimed a broken axle; in rags he stirred slander, discarded promises and faults, and insulted a noble clan in court.
units.literal: The day when the feast of merit was held, merit slight yet reward thick—out as governor of a famous commandery, in as overseer of a department—gift baskets not forgotten, yet he falsely claimed broken axle; dress in rags, slander stirred out of place, promises and faults discarded, court insult to a noble clan.

units.zh: 自居樞憲，糾奏寂寞。
units.en: Since he took the pivot of the censorate, impeachments have been silent.
units.literal: Since taking the pivot of censorate, memorials of impeachment have been silent.

units.zh: 顧望縱容，無至公之議；
units.en: He looks about and indulges, with no debate of utmost public right;
units.literal: Looking about and indulging, no debate of utmost public right;

units.zh: 惡直醜正，有私訐之談。
units.en: he hates the straight and uglifies the correct, and has private impeachment talk.
units.literal: hating the straight and uglifying the correct, having private impeachment talk.

units.zh: 宜置之徽纆，肅正國典。
units.en: He should be placed in fetters to rectify the national statutes.
units.literal: He should be placed in fetters to rectify the national statutes.

units.zh: 臣等參議，請以見事免縝所居官，輒勒外收付廷尉法獄治罪。
units.en: Your servant and others jointly recommend that Zhen be removed from his present office on the facts before us, and that the outer offices at once take him and deliver him to the Court of Justice law prison for punishment.
units.literal: Your servant and others jointly recommend: remove Zhen from his present office on the facts before us, and at once command the outer offices to take him and deliver to the law prison of the Court of Justice for punishment.

units.zh: 應諸連逮，委之獄官，以法制從事。
units.en: All who should be implicated and seized, entrust to the prison officers to proceed by statute.
units.literal: All who should be implicated and seized, entrust to the prison officers to proceed by statute.

units.zh: 縝位應黃紙，臣輒奉白簡。
units.en: Zhen's post requires yellow paper—your servant hastens to present white bamboo slips.
units.literal: Zhen's post requires yellow paper—your servant hastens to present white bamboo slips.

units.zh: 詔聞可。
units.en: Edict: Approved.
units.literal: Edict: Approved.

units.zh: 璽書詰縝曰：「亮少乏才能，無聞時輩，昔經冒入羣英，相與豈薄，晚節諂事江祏，爲吏部，末協附梅蟲兒、茹法珍，遂執昏政。
units.en: An imperial letter reprimanded Zhen: "Liang in youth lacked talent and was unknown among his peers; formerly he rashly entered the ranks of worthies—we were not thin with one another; in his later years he flattered Jiang Shi; as director of personnel he finally joined Mei Chong'er and Ru Fazhen and held benighted government.
units.literal: An imperial letter reprimanded Zhen: "Liang in youth lacked talent and was unknown among contemporaries; formerly he rashly entered the ranks of worthies—we with one another were not thin; in his later years he flattered Jiang Shi; as Director of Personnel he finally joined with Mei Chong'er and Ru Fazhen and so held benighted government.

units.zh: 比屋罹禍，盡家塗炭，四海沸騰，天下橫潰，此誰之咎！
units.en: Household upon household met disaster, whole families were scorched; the four seas seethed, the realm collapsed—whose fault is this!
units.literal: Household upon household met disaster, whole families were scorched; the four seas seethed, the realm collapsed—whose fault is this!

units.zh: 食亂君之祿，不死於治世。
units.en: He ate the salary of a chaotic lord yet did not die in an age of order.
units.literal: He ate the salary of a chaotic lord yet did not die in an age of order.

units.zh: 亮協固凶黨，作威作福，靡衣玉食，女樂盈房，勢危事逼，自相吞噬。
units.en: Liang joined the vicious faction, made might and made blessing, fine clothes and jade food, female musicians filling the rooms; when peril pressed and business forced, they devoured one another.
units.literal: Liang solidified with the vicious faction, made might and made blessing, fine clothes and jade food, female musicians filling the rooms; when peril pressed and business forced, they devoured one another.

units.zh: 建石首題，啓靡請罪。
units.en: At Jianshi he put his head on the first draft, opened up, and asked only for punishment.
units.literal: At Jianshi he put his head on the first draft, opened up, and asked only for punishment.

units.zh: 朕錄其白旗之來，貰其旣往之咎。
units.en: I recorded his coming under the white flag and pardoned his past fault.
units.literal: I recorded his coming under the white flag and pardoned his past fault.

units.zh: 亮反覆不忠，姦賄彰暴，有何可論！
units.en: Liang was faithless and shifting, corruption and bribes openly violent—what is there to discuss!
units.literal: Liang was faithless and shifting, corruption and bribes openly violent—what is there to discuss!

units.zh: 妄相談述，具以狀對。」
units.en: Rashly to talk and narrate such—report fully in a memorial for judgment."
units.literal: Rashly to talk and narrate such—fully report by memorial for judgment."

units.zh: 所詰十條，縝答支離而已。
units.en: The ten points of censure—Zhen's answers were disjointed only.
units.literal: The ten points of censure—Zhen's answers were disjointed only.

units.zh: 亮因屏居閉掃，不通賓客。
units.en: Liang then lived in seclusion, swept his quarters, and received no guests.
units.literal: Liang then lived in seclusion, swept his quarters, and received no guests.

units.zh: 遭母憂，居喪盡禮。
units.en: When his mother died he observed mourning in full ritual.
units.literal: When his mother died he observed mourning in full ritual.

units.zh: 八年，詔起爲秘書監，俄加通直散騎常侍，數日遷太常卿。
units.en: In the eighth year an edict recalled him as director of the secretariat; soon he was further made regular attendant cavalier attendant-in-ordinary, and within days rose to minister of ceremonies.
units.literal: In the eighth year an edict recalled him as Director of the Secretariat; soon he was further made Regular Attendant Cavalier Attendant-in-Ordinary, and within days was promoted to Minister of Ceremonies.

units.zh: 九年，轉中書監，加散騎常侍。
units.en: In the ninth year he was transferred to director of the secretariat with additional cavalier attendant-in-ordinary.
units.literal: In the ninth year he was transferred to Director of the Secretariat with additional Cavalier Attendant-in-Ordinary.

units.zh: 其年卒。
units.en: That year he died.
units.literal: That year he died.

units.zh: 詔賻錢三萬，布五十匹。
units.en: An edict granted thirty thousand cash and fifty bolts of cloth for funeral expenses.
units.literal: An edict granted thirty thousand cash and fifty bolts of cloth for funeral expenses.

units.zh: 諡曰煬子。
units.en: Posthumous title: Son Yang.
units.literal: Posthumous title: Son Yang.

units.zh: 張稷字公喬，吳郡人也。
units.en: Zhang Ji, styled Gongqiao, was a man of Wu commandery.
units.literal: Zhang Ji, styled Gongqiao, was a native of Wu commandery.

units.zh: 父永，宋右光祿大夫。
units.en: His father Yong was Song right grand master of splendid happiness.
units.literal: His father Yong was Song Right Grand Master of Splendid Happiness.

units.zh: 稷所生母遘疾歷時，稷始年十一，夜不解衣而養，永異之。
units.en: Ji's birth mother had long been ill; when Ji was eleven he would not unbind his clothes to nurse her—Yong marveled at this.
units.literal: Ji's birth mother had long been ill; when Ji was eleven he did not unbind his clothes to nurse her—Yong marveled at this.

units.zh: 及母亡，毀瘠過人，杖而後起。
units.en: When his mother died his grief-wasting exceeded others; he rose only with a staff's support.
units.literal: When his mother died his grief-wasting exceeded others; he rose only with a staff's support.

units.zh: 性疏率，朗悟有才略，與族兄充、融、卷等俱知名，時稱之曰：「充融卷稷，是爲四張。」
units.en: By nature he was careless and open, bright with talent and stratagem; with his kinsmen Chong, Rong, and Juan he was all famed—the age called them, "Chong, Rong, Juan, and Ji—that is the Four Zhangs."
units.literal: By nature he was careless and open, bright and perceptive with talent and stratagem; with his kinsmen Chong, Rong, and Juan he was all famed—the age called them: "Chong, Rong, Juan, and Ji—that is the Four Zhangs."

units.zh: 起家著作佐郎，不拜，頻居父母憂，六載廬于墓側。
units.en: He began as editorial assistant in the masters of writing but did not accept; he repeatedly sat parents' mourning, six years dwelling by the tomb.
units.literal: He began office as Editorial Assistant in the Masters of Writing but did not accept; he repeatedly sat parents' mourning, six years dwelling by the tomb.

units.zh: 服除，爲驃騎法曹行參軍，遷外兵參軍。
units.en: When mourning ended he was rapid-cavalry law bureau acting staff officer, then outer army staff officer.
units.literal: When mourning ended he was Rapid Cavalry Law Bureau Acting Staff Officer, promoted to Outer Army Staff Officer.

units.zh: 齊永明中，爲剡縣令，略不視事，多爲山水遊。
units.en: In Qi's Yongming era he was Shan county magistrate, scarcely overseeing affairs, often roaming mountains and waters.
units.literal: In Qi's Yongming era he was Governor of Shan County, scarcely overseeing affairs, often roaming mountains and waters.

units.zh: 會賊唐㝢之作亂，稷率厲縣人，保全縣境。
units.en: When the bandit Tang Yuzhi rebelled, Ji led and encouraged the county people and preserved the county territory.
units.literal: When the bandit Tang Yuzhi rebelled, Ji led and encouraged the county people and preserved the county territory.

units.zh: 入爲太子洗馬，大司馬東曹掾，建安王友，大司馬從事中郎。
units.en: He entered as crown prince purifier, eastern bureau staff officer to the grand marshal, friend to the prince of Jian'an, and chief staff officer to the grand marshal.
units.literal: He entered office as Crown Prince Purifier, Eastern Bureau Staff Officer to the Grand Marshal, Friend to the Prince of Jian'an, and Chief Staff Officer to the Grand Marshal.

units.zh: 武陵王曅爲護軍，轉護軍司馬，尋爲本州治中。
units.en: When the prince of Wuling was guard general, Ji was transferred to guard general staff officer, soon made chief administrator of his native province.
units.literal: When Prince of Wuling Ye was Guard General, Ji was transferred to Guard General Staff Officer, soon made Chief Administrator of his native province.

units.zh: 明帝領牧，仍爲別駕。
units.en: When Emperor Ming held the governorship, Ji remained as vice governor.
units.literal: When Emperor Ming held the governorship, Ji remained as Vice Governor.

units.zh: 時魏寇壽春，以稷爲寧朔將軍、軍主，副尚書僕射沈文季鎮豫州。
units.en: At the time Wei raided Shouchun; Ji was made pacifying-the-north general and army commander, assisting right vice director Shen Wenji in guarding Yuzhou.
units.literal: At the time Wei raided Shouchun; Ji was made Pacifying the North General and army commander, assisting Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Shen Wenji in guarding Yuzhou.

units.zh: 魏衆稱百萬，圍城累日，時經略處分，文季悉委稷焉。
units.en: Wei forces were said to number a million and besieged the city for many days; all planning and disposition Wenji wholly entrusted to Ji.
units.literal: Wei forces were said to number a million and besieged the city for many days; all planning and disposition Wenji wholly entrusted to Ji.

units.zh: 軍退，遷平西司馬、寧朔將軍、南平內史。
units.en: When the army withdrew, he was promoted to pacifying-the-west staff officer, pacifying-the-north general, and Nanping interior governor.
units.literal: When the army withdrew, he was promoted to Pacifying the West Staff Officer, Pacifying the North General, and Interior Governor of Nanping.

units.zh: 魏又寇雍州，詔以本號都督荊、雍諸軍事。
units.en: Wei again raided Yong province; an edict made him with his present title commander of military affairs in Jing and Yong.
units.literal: Wei again raided Yong Province; an edict made him with his present title Commander of military affairs in Jing and Yong.

units.zh: 時雍州刺史曹虎度樊城岸，以稷知州事。
units.en: At the time Cao Hu, Inspector of Yong Province, crossed to the Fancheng bank, and Ji was put in charge of provincial affairs.
units.literal: At the time Cao Hu, Inspector of Yong Province, crossed to the Fancheng bank, and Ji was made acting administrator of the province.

units.zh: 魏師退，稷還荊州，就拜黃門侍郎，復爲司馬、新興、永寧二郡太守。
units.en: When Wei forces withdrew, Ji returned to Jing province and was at once appointed yellow gate gentleman, again made staff officer and governor of Xinxing and Yongning.
units.literal: When Wei forces withdrew, Ji returned to Jing Province and was at once appointed Yellow Gate Gentleman, again made Staff Officer and Governor of both Xinxing and Yongning commanderies.

units.zh: 郡犯私諱，改永寧爲長寧。
units.en: The commandery violated a private taboo, so Yongning was changed to Changning.
units.literal: The commandery violated a private taboo, so Yongning was changed to Changning.

units.zh: 尋遷司徒司馬，加輔國將軍。
units.en: Soon he was promoted to grand marshal staff officer with additional assistant state general.
units.literal: Soon he was promoted to Grand Marshal Staff Officer with additional Assistant State General.

units.zh: 及江州刺史陳顯達舉兵反，以本號鎮歷陽、南譙二郡太守，遷鎮南長史、尋陽太守、輔國將軍、行江州事。
units.en: When Jiangzhou inspector Chen Xianda raised troops in rebellion, with his present title he was made governor of Liyang and Nanqiao, promoted to pacifying-the-south chief staff officer, Xunyang governor, assistant state general, and acting Jiangzhou affairs.
units.literal: When Jiangzhou Inspector Chen Xianda raised troops in rebellion, with his present title he was made Governor of both Liyang and Nanqiao commanderies, promoted to Pacifying the South Chief Staff Officer, Xunyang Governor, Assistant State General, and Acting Jiangzhou Affairs.

units.zh: 尋徵還，爲持節、輔國將軍、都督北徐州諸軍事、北徐州刺史。
units.en: Soon recalled, he became bearer of credentials, General Who Assists the State, area commander of North Xuzhou, and North Xuzhou inspector.
units.literal: Soon he was recalled and made Bearer of Credentials, General Who Assists the State, Area Commander of all North Xuzhou military affairs, and North Xuzhou Inspector.

units.zh: 出次白下，仍遷都督南兗州諸軍事、南兗州刺史。
units.en: He posted at Baixia, then became area commander of South Yanzhou and South Yanzhou inspector.
units.literal: He posted at Baixia, then was transferred to Area Commander of all South Yanzhou military affairs and South Yanzhou Inspector.

units.zh: 俄進督北徐、徐、兗、青、冀五州諸軍事，將軍並如故。
units.en: Soon he was advanced to command the five provinces North Xu, Xu, Yan, Qing, and Ji, with his general ranks unchanged.
units.literal: Soon he was advanced to command military affairs in North Xu, Xu, Yan, Qing, and Ji—five provinces in all—while his general ranks remained as before.

units.zh: 永元末，徵爲侍中，宿衛宮城。
units.en: At the end of Yongyuan he was summoned as attendant within and guarded the palace city.
units.literal: At the end of the Yongyuan era he was summoned as Attendant Within and guarded the palace city.

units.zh: 義師至，兼衛尉江淹出奔。
units.en: When the righteous army came, Concurrent Commandant of the Guard Jiang Yan fled.
units.literal: When the Righteous Army arrived, Concurrent Commandant of the Guard Jiang Yan fled.

units.zh: 稷兼衛尉，副王瑩都督城內諸軍事。
units.en: Ji held the concurrent guard commandancy and assisted Wang Ying in commanding the city's forces.
units.literal: Ji held the concurrent commandantship and assisted Wang Ying in commanding all military affairs within the city.

units.zh: 時東昏淫虐，義師圍城已久，城內思亡而莫有先發。
units.en: Donghun was depraved and cruel; the righteous army had long besieged the city, and everyone inside wished to turn, yet none dared move first.
units.literal: Donghun was then depraved and cruel; the Righteous Army had besieged the city for a long time, and within the walls all wished to rebel, yet none dared act first.

units.zh: 北徐州刺史王珍國就稷謀之，乃使直閤張齊害東昏于含德殿。
units.en: North Xuzhou inspector Wang Zhenguo plotted with Ji; Ji had Direct Attendant Zhang Qi kill Donghun in Hede Hall.
units.literal: North Xuzhou Inspector Wang Zhenguo consulted with Ji; Ji then had Direct Attendant Zhang Qi kill Donghun in Hede Hall.

units.zh: 稷召尚書右僕射王亮等列坐殿前西鐘下，謂曰：「昔桀有昏德，鼎遷于殷；
units.en: Ji summoned Right Vice Director Wang Liang and others to sit before the western bell in the hall and said, "Of old Jie had dark virtue, and the tripod moved to Yin;
units.literal: Ji summoned Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Wang Liang and others to sit in a row before the western bell in the hall and said: "Of old Jie had dark virtue, and the tripod moved to Yin;

units.zh: 商紂暴虐，鼎遷于周。
units.en: Shang's Zhou was violent and cruel, and the tripod moved to Zhou.
units.literal: Shang's Zhou was violent and cruel, and the tripod moved to Zhou.

units.zh: 今獨夫自絕于天，四海已歸聖主，斯實微子去殷之時，項伯歸漢之日，可不勉哉！」
units.en: Now the tyrant has cut himself off from Heaven; the four seas already belong to the sage lord—this is Weizi leaving Yin, Xiang Bo returning to Han. You must exert yourselves!"
units.literal: Now the lone man has cut himself off from Heaven; the four seas already belong to the sage lord—this is truly the time of Weizi leaving Yin, Xiang Bo returning to Han. You must exert yourselves!"

units.zh: 乃遣國子博士范雲、舍人裴長穆等使石頭城詣高祖，高祖以稷爲侍中、左衛將軍。
units.en: Then he sent National University erudite Fan Yun, attendant Pei Changmu, and others to Stone City to see Gaozu; Gaozu made Ji attendant within and left palace guard general.
units.literal: Then he sent National University Erudite Fan Yun, Attendant Pei Changmu, and others to Stone City to present themselves to Gaozu; Gaozu made Ji Attendant Within and Left Palace Guard General.

units.zh: 高祖總百揆，遷大司馬左司馬。
units.en: When Gaozu took charge of all affairs, Ji became the grand marshal's left staff officer.
units.literal: When Gaozu oversaw all state affairs, Ji was transferred to Left Staff Officer of the Grand Marshal.

units.zh: 梁臺建，爲散騎常侍、中書令。
units.en: When the Liang court was set up he became cavalier attendant-in-ordinary and director of the secretariat.
units.literal: When the Liang regime was established he was made Cavalier Attendant-in-Ordinary and Director of the Secretariat.

units.zh: 高祖受禪，以功封江安縣侯，邑一千戶。
units.en: When Gaozu took the throne, Ji was enfeoffed as Marquis of Jiang'an for merit, with a fief of one thousand households.
units.literal: When Gaozu accepted the abdication, Ji was enfeoffed as Marquis of Jiang'an for his merit, with a fief of one thousand households.

units.zh: 又爲侍中、國子祭酒，領驍騎將軍，遷護軍將軍、揚州大中正，以事免。
units.en: He again became attendant within and chancellor of the National University, with concurrent rapid cavalry general; he became protector general and Yangzhou chief rectifier, then was dismissed over an affair.
units.literal: He was again made Attendant Within and Chancellor of the National University, with concurrent Rapid Cavalry General; he was transferred to Protector General and Yangzhou Chief Rectifier, then dismissed over an affair.

units.zh: 尋爲度支尚書、前將軍、太子右衛率，又以公事免。
units.en: Soon he became minister of revenue, front general, and right crown prince palace guard commander, then was again dismissed over official business.
units.literal: Soon he was made Minister of Revenue, Front General, and Right Crown Prince Palace Guard Commander, then again dismissed over an official matter.

units.zh: 俄爲祠部尚書，轉散騎常侍、都官尚書、揚州大中正，以本職知領軍事。
units.en: Soon he became minister of sacrificial affairs, then cavalier attendant, director of capital crimes, and Yangzhou chief rectifier, concurrently commanding guard-army affairs.
units.literal: Soon he was made Minister of Sacrificial Affairs, then transferred to Cavalier Attendant-in-Ordinary, Director of Capital Crimes, and Yangzhou Chief Rectifier, with this office concurrently in charge of guard-army affairs.

units.zh: 尋遷領軍將軍，中正、侯如故。
units.en: Soon he became guard army general, keeping his chief rectifier title and marquisate.
units.literal: Soon he was transferred to Guard Army General, his chief rectifier title and marquisate remaining as before.

units.zh: 時魏寇青州，詔假節、行州事。
units.en: Wei then invaded Qingzhou; he was ordered to hold temporary credentials and act for the province.
units.literal: At that time Wei invaded Qingzhou; an edict granted him temporary credentials and acting charge of the province.

units.zh: 會魏軍退，仍出爲散騎常侍、將軍，吳興太守，秩中二千石。
units.en: When the Wei army withdrew he went out as cavalier attendant and general, Wuxing administrator, at salary rank two thousand dan.
units.literal: When the Wei army withdrew he went out as Cavalier Attendant-in-Ordinary and General, Wuxing Administrator, with salary rank at two thousand dan.

units.zh: 下車存問遺老，引其子孫，置之右職，政稱寬恕。
units.en: On taking office he sought out old residents and set their sons and grandsons in right offices; his rule was called lenient and forgiving.
units.literal: On taking office he inquired after the old residents left behind and promoted their sons and grandsons to right offices; his governance was called lenient and forgiving.

units.zh: 進號雲麾將軍，徵尚書左僕射。
units.en: He was advanced to Cloud-Banner General and summoned as left vice director of the Masters of Writing.
units.literal: His title was advanced to Cloud-Banner General and he was summoned as Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.

units.zh: 輿駕將欲如稷宅，以盛暑，留幸僕射省，舊臨幸供具皆酬太官饌直，帝以稷清貧，手詔不受。
units.en: The emperor was about to visit Ji's house; in the intense heat he stayed at the vice director's office instead. Old custom reimbursed visit supplies from the Grand Provisioner; because Ji was poor, the emperor personally issued an edict that he accept nothing.
units.literal: The imperial carriage was about to visit Ji's house; because of the intense heat the Emperor stayed instead at the Vice Director's office. By old custom items for an imperial visit were reimbursed from the Grand Provisioner's feast allowance; because Ji was pure and poor, the Emperor personally issued an edict that he should not accept them.

units.zh: 出爲使持節、散騎常侍、都督青、冀二州諸軍事、安北將軍、青、冀二州刺史。
units.en: He went out as bearer of credentials, cavalier attendant, area commander of Qing and Ji, Pacification North general, and inspector of Qing and Ji.
units.literal: He went out as Bearer of Credentials, Cavalier Attendant-in-Ordinary, Area Commander of Qing and Ji military affairs, Pacification North General, and Inspector of Qing and Ji provinces.

units.zh: 會魏寇朐山，詔稷權頓六里，都督衆軍。
units.en: When Wei invaded Qushan, Ji was ordered to hold Liuli temporarily and command all armies.
units.literal: When Wei invaded Qushan, an edict ordered Ji to station temporarily at Liuli and command all armies.

units.zh: 還，進號鎮北將軍。
units.en: On return his title was advanced to Garrison North general.
units.literal: On his return his title was advanced to Garrison North General.

units.zh: 初鬱洲接邊陲，民俗多與魏人交市。
units.en: Earlier Yuzhou lay on the frontier, and its people often traded with Wei.
units.literal: Earlier Yuzhou bordered the frontier, and local custom often led people to trade with Wei.

units.zh: 及朐山叛，或與魏通，旣不自安矣；
units.en: When Qushan rebelled, some made contact with Wei; they were already uneasy;
units.literal: When Qushan rebelled, some connected with Wei; they were already uneasy;

units.zh: 且稷寬弛無防，僚吏頗侵漁之。
units.en: moreover Ji was lax and undefended, and his staff often preyed on the province.
units.literal: moreover Ji was lax and undefended, and his staff often encroached and fleeced.

units.zh: 州人徐道角等夜襲州城，害稷，時年六十三。
units.en: Provincial men Xu Daojiao and others attacked the seat by night and killed Ji, aged sixty-three.
units.literal: Provincial men Xu Daojiao and others night-attacked the provincial seat and killed Ji; he was sixty-three.

units.zh: 有司奏削爵土。
units.en: The responsible office memorialized to strip his fief and lands.
units.literal: The responsible office memorialized to strip his enfeoffment and lands.

units.zh: 稷性烈亮，善與人交。
units.en: Ji was fierce and bright, and good at friendship.
units.literal: Ji's nature was fierce and bright, and he was good at making friends.

units.zh: 歷官無蓄聚，俸祿皆頒之親故，家無餘財。
units.en: He never hoarded in office; he gave his salary to kin and friends, and his house held no surplus.
units.literal: In office he never accumulated wealth; his salary he always distributed to kin and friends, and his house had no surplus.

units.zh: 初去吳興郡，以僕射徵，道由吳鄉，候稷者滿水陸。
units.en: When he first left Wuxing and was summoned as vice director, his route passed Wu country; those waiting for Ji filled land and water.
units.literal: When he first left Wuxing commandery and was summoned as Vice Director, his route passed his Wu homeland; those waiting to see Ji filled the waterways and roads.

units.zh: 稷單裝徑還京師，人莫之識，其率素如此。
units.en: Ji returned to the capital alone with plain baggage; no one knew him—such was his austerity.
units.literal: Ji returned to the capital alone with simple baggage; no one recognized him—such was his plain simplicity.

units.zh: 稷長女楚瑗，適會稽孔氏，無子歸宗。
units.en: Ji's eldest daughter Chu Yuan married the Kong clan of Kuaiji; childless, she returned to her clan.
units.literal: Ji's eldest daughter Chu Yuan married into the Kong clan of Kuaiji; having no son, she returned to her clan.

units.zh: 至稷見害，女以身蔽刃，先父卒。
units.en: When Ji was killed, his daughter shielded him with her body and died before her father.
units.literal: When Ji was killed, his daughter used her body to shield the blade and died before her father.

units.zh: 稷子嵊，別有傳。
units.en: Ji's son Song has a separate biography.
units.literal: Ji's son Song has a separate biography.

units.zh: 卷字令遠，稷從兄也。
units.en: Juan, styled Lingyuan, was Ji's cousin.
units.literal: Juan, styled Lingyuan, was Ji's cousin.

units.zh: 少以知理著稱，能清言，仕至都官尚書，天監初卒。
units.en: In youth he was famed for grasping principle and pure talk; he reached director of capital crimes and died early in Tianjian.
units.literal: In youth he was famed for grasping principle, could hold pure talk, and reached Capital Crimes Director in office; he died early in the Tianjian era.

units.zh: 王瑩字奉光，琅邪臨沂人也。
units.en: Wang Ying, styled Fengguang, came from Linyi in Langye.
units.literal: Wang Ying, styled Fengguang, was a native of Linyi in Langye.

units.zh: 父懋，光祿大夫、南鄉僖侯。
units.en: His father Mao was grand master of splendid happiness and Marquis Xi of Nanxiang.
units.literal: His father Mao was Grand Master of Splendid Happiness and Marquis Xi of Nanxiang.

units.zh: 瑩選尚宋臨淮公主，拜駙馬都尉，除著作佐郎，累遷太子舍人，撫軍功曹，散騎侍郎，司徒左西屬。
units.en: Ying was chosen to marry Song's Princess of Linhuai, became commandant of the horse guards, left the Masters of Writing aide post, and rose to crown prince attendant, pacification army staff officer, cavalier attendant, and left western aide of the secretariat.
units.literal: Ying was chosen to marry the Princess of Linhuai of Song, was made Commandant of the Horse Guards, removed as Aide in the Masters of Writing, and rose through offices to Crown Prince Attendant, Pacification Army Staff Officer, and Cavalier Attendant-in-Ordinary, then Left Western Aide of the Secretariat.

units.zh: 齊高帝爲驃騎將軍，引爲從事中郎。
units.en: When Qi Gaodi was Rapid Cavalry General, he brought Ying in as participation officer.
units.literal: When Qi Gaodi was Rapid Cavalry General, he brought Ying in as participation officer.

units.zh: 頃之，出爲義興太守，代謝超宗。
units.en: Soon he went out as Yixing administrator, replacing Xie Chaozong.
units.literal: Shortly after, he went out as Yixing Administrator, replacing Xie Chaozong.

units.zh: 超宗去郡，與瑩交惡，旣還，間瑩於懋。
units.en: Chaozong left the commandery on bad terms with Ying; back in the capital he slandered Ying to Mao.
units.literal: When Chaozong left the commandery he and Ying had become enemies; once back in the capital he slandered Ying to Mao.

units.zh: 懋言之於朝廷，以瑩供養不足，坐失郡廢棄。
units.en: Mao raised it at court; Ying's upkeep of office was judged insufficient, and he lost his commandery and was cast aside.
units.literal: Mao spoke of it at court; because Ying's support of his post was insufficient, he was dismissed from his commandery and cast aside.

units.zh: 久之，爲前軍諮議參軍，中書侍郎，大司馬從事中郎，未拜，丁母憂。
units.en: Long after, he became advisory staff officer of the Front Army, Gentleman of the Palace Secretariat, and Gentleman of the Grand Marshal's staff; before taking up the post, he went into mourning for his mother.
units.literal: After a long while he was made Advisory Staff Officer of the Front Army, Gentleman of the Palace Secretariat, and Gentleman of the Grand Marshal's staff; before he could take up the post, he entered mourning for his mother.

units.zh: 服闋，爲給事黃門郎，出爲宣城太守，遷爲驃騎長史。
units.en: After mourning he became yellow gate attendant, went out as Xuancheng administrator, then rapid cavalry chief clerk.
units.literal: When mourning ended he was made Yellow Gate Attendant, went out as Xuancheng Administrator, and was transferred to Rapid Cavalry Chief Clerk.

units.zh: 復爲黃門侍郎、司馬、太子中庶子，仍遷侍中，父憂去職。
units.en: He again became Attendant Gentleman of the Yellow Gate, Marshal, and Junior Mentor in the heir apparent's household, and soon became Attendant-in-Ordinary; he left office to mourn his father.
units.literal: He was again made Attendant Gentleman of the Yellow Gate, Marshal, and Junior Mentor in the heir apparent's household, and soon transferred to Attendant-in-Ordinary; he left office for his father's mourning.

units.zh: 服闋，復爲侍中，領射聲校尉，又爲冠軍將軍、東陽太守。
units.en: After mourning he again became attendant within and colonel of the archers' guard, then champion general and Dongyang administrator.
units.literal: When mourning ended he was again made Attendant Within with concurrent Colonel of the Archers' Guard, then Champion General and Dongyang Administrator.

units.zh: 居郡有惠政，遷吳興太守。
units.en: In office he ruled with benevolence and was transferred to Wuxing administrator.
units.literal: In the commandery he had benevolent government and was transferred to Wuxing Administrator.

units.zh: 明帝勤憂庶政，瑩頻處二郡，皆有能名。
units.en: Mingdi toiled over common government; Ying twice held commanderies and in both won a name for ability.
units.literal: Mingdi labored anxiously over common government; Ying twice held commanderies and in both had a name for ability.

units.zh: 甚見褒美。
units.en: He was greatly praised.
units.literal: He was greatly praised.

units.zh: 還爲太子詹事、中領軍。
units.en: On return he became crown prince grand tutor and central army commander.
units.literal: On his return he was made Crown Prince Grand Tutor and Central Army Commander.

units.zh: 永元初，政由羣小，瑩守職而不能有所是非。
units.en: At the start of Yongyuan petty men held power; Ying kept his post but could not speak on right and wrong.
units.literal: At the start of Yongyuan, government lay with petty men; Ying kept his post but could not judge right and wrong.

units.zh: 瑩從弟亮旣當朝，於瑩素雖不善，時欲引與同事。
units.en: Cousin Liang was then in power; though never close to Ying, he now wished to draw him into shared office.
units.literal: Ying's cousin Liang was then in power; though he had never been close to Ying, he now wished to draw him into shared office.

units.zh: 遷尚書左僕射，未拜。
units.en: He was transferred to left vice director but did not take up the post.
units.literal: He was transferred to Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing but did not take up the post.

units.zh: 會護軍崔慧景自京口奉江夏王入伐，瑩假節，率衆拒慧景於湖頭，夜爲慧景所襲，衆散，瑩赴水，乘榜入樂遊，因得還臺城。
units.en: When Protector General Cui Huijing raised the Prince of Jiangxia from Jingkou, Ying held temporary credentials, led troops to resist Huijing at Hutou, was night-attacked, his host scattered, threw himself into the water, rafted into Le You, and so returned to the terrace city.
units.literal: When Protector General Cui Huijing raised the Prince of Jiangxia from Jingkou in revolt, Ying was granted temporary credentials, led troops to resist Huijing at Hutou, was night-attacked by Huijing, his host scattered, and Ying threw himself into the water and entered Le You on a raft, thereby returning to the terrace city.

units.zh: 慧景敗，還居領軍府。
units.en: When Huijing was defeated, Ying returned to the defender-in-chief's residence.
units.literal: When Huijing was defeated, Ying returned to the Defender-in-Chief's residence.

units.zh: 義師至，復假節，都督宮城諸軍事。
units.en: When the righteous army came, he again held temporary credentials and commanded palace-city forces.
units.literal: When the Righteous Army arrived, he was again granted temporary credentials and made Area Commander of all palace-city military affairs.

units.zh: 建康平，高祖爲相國，引瑩爲左長史，加冠軍將軍，奉法駕迎和帝于江陵。
units.en: When Jiankang was pacified, Gaozu as chancellor of state brought Ying in as left chief clerk, advanced him to champion general, and had him escort the imperial carriage to welcome Emperor He from Jiangling.
units.literal: When Jiankang was pacified, Gaozu as Chancellor of State brought Ying in as Left Chief Clerk, advanced him to Champion General, and had him escort the imperial carriage to welcome Emperor He from Jiangling.

units.zh: 帝至南州，遜位于別宮。
units.en: When the emperor reached Southern Province, he abdicated at a separate palace.
units.literal: When the Emperor reached Southern Province, he abdicated at a separate palace.

units.zh: 高祖踐阼，遷侍中、撫軍將軍，封建城縣公，邑千戶。
units.en: When Gaozu took the throne, Ying became attendant within and pacification army general, enfeoffed as Duke of Jiancheng with a fief of one thousand households.
units.literal: When Gaozu ascended the throne, Ying was transferred to Attendant Within and Pacification Army General, enfeoffed as Duke of Jiancheng with a fief of one thousand households.

units.zh: 尋遷尚書左僕射，侍中、撫軍如故。
units.en: Soon he became Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, keeping his titles of Attendant-in-Ordinary and General Who Pacifies the Army.
units.literal: Soon he was transferred to Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, with Attendant-in-Ordinary and General Who Pacifies the Army as before.

units.zh: 頃之，爲護軍將軍，復遷散騎常侍、中軍將軍、丹陽尹。
units.en: Soon he became protector general, then cavalier attendant, central army general, and Danyang intendant.
units.literal: Shortly after, he was made Protector General, then transferred to Cavalier Attendant-in-Ordinary, Central Army General, and Danyang Intendant.

units.zh: 視事三年，遷侍中、光祿大夫，領左衛將軍。
units.en: After three years in office he became attendant within and grand master of splendid happiness, with concurrent left palace guard general.
units.literal: After three years in office he was transferred to Attendant Within and Grand Master of Splendid Happiness, with concurrent Left Palace Guard General.

units.zh: 俄遷尚書令、雲麾將軍，侍中如故。
units.en: Soon he became director of the Masters of Writing and Cloud-Banner general, keeping attendant within.
units.literal: Soon he was transferred to Director of the Masters of Writing and Cloud-Banner General, his attendant within title remaining as before.

units.zh: 累進號左中權將軍，給鼓吹一部。
units.en: He was repeatedly advanced to Left Central Authority general and granted one set of pipes and drums.
units.literal: He was repeatedly advanced in title to Left Central Authority General and granted one set of martial pipes and drums.

units.zh: 瑩性清慎，居官恭恪，高祖深重之。
units.en: Ying was pure and cautious; in office he was respectful and earnest, and Gaozu valued him deeply.
units.literal: Ying's nature was pure and cautious; in office he was respectful and earnest, and Gaozu valued him deeply.

units.zh: 天監十五年，遷左光祿大夫、開府儀同三司，丹陽尹、侍中如故。
units.en: In Tianjian year fifteen he became left minister of the imperial clan with open office and third-rank ceremonial parity, keeping Danyang intendant and attendant within.
units.literal: In the fifteenth year of Tianjian he was transferred to Left Minister of the Household for the Imperial Clan, open office with third-rank ceremonial parity, his Danyang intendant and attendant within titles remaining as before.

units.zh: 瑩將拜，印工鑄其印，六鑄而龜六毀，旣成，頸空不實，補而用之。
units.en: When Ying was about to take office, seal craftsmen cast his seal; six castings ruined six tortoises; when finished the neck was hollow, yet they patched it and used it.
units.literal: When Ying was about to take his appointment, the seal craftsmen cast his seal; six castings and six times the tortoise was ruined; once finished, the neck was hollow and not solid, yet they patched it and used it.

units.zh: 居職六日，暴疾卒。
units.en: After six days in office he died suddenly.
units.literal: After six days in office he died suddenly of illness.

units.zh: 贈侍中、左光祿大夫、開府儀同三司。
units.en: Posthumously he was made attendant within, left minister of the imperial clan, and open office with third-rank ceremonial parity.
units.literal: He was posthumously made Attendant Within, Left Minister of the Household for the Imperial Clan, and open office with third-rank ceremonial parity.

units.zh: 陳吏部尚書姚察曰：孔子稱「殷有三仁：微子去之，箕子爲之奴，比干諫而死。」
units.en: Chen Minister of Personnel Yao Cha said: Confucius said, "Yin had three worthies: Weizi left; Jizi became a slave; Bigan remonstrated and died."
units.literal: Chen Minister of Personnel Yao Cha said: Confucius said, "Yin had three worthies: Weizi left it; Jizi became its slave; Bigan remonstrated and died."

units.zh: 王亮之居亂世，勢位見矣。
units.en: Wang Liang's standing in chaotic times—rank and position were plain to see.
units.literal: Wang Liang's standing in a chaotic age—his rank and position were plain to see.

units.zh: 其于取捨，何與三仁之異歟？
units.en: In what he took and rejected, how did he differ from the three worthies?
units.literal: In what he took and rejected, how did he differ from the three worthies?

units.zh: 及奉興王，蒙寬政，爲佐命，固將愧於心。
units.en: Yet serving the Rising King under lenient rule and helping found the dynasty, he must have felt shame at heart.
units.literal: Yet when he served the Rising King, he received lenient policy and helped found the dynasty—he must surely have felt shame at heart.

units.zh: 乃自取廢敗，非不幸也。
units.en: Then he brought ruin on himself—not misfortune.
units.literal: Then he brought ruin on himself—not misfortune.

units.zh: 《易》曰：「非所據而據之，身必危。」
units.en: The Changes says, "Occupy what is not yours to occupy, and the body must be in peril."
units.literal: The Changes says: "When one occupies what is not one's to occupy, the body must be in peril."

units.zh: 亮之進退，失所據矣。
units.en: In advance and retreat, Liang lost what he should have stood on.
units.literal: In advance and retreat, Liang lost what he should have stood on.

units.zh: 惜哉！
units.en: Pity!
units.literal: Pity!

units.zh: 張稷因機制變，亦其時也。
units.en: Zhang Ji seized the moment to shift course—that too was its time.
units.literal: Zhang Ji seized the moment to shift course—that too was its time.

units.zh: 王瑩印章六毀，豈神之害盈乎？
units.en: Wang Ying's seal was cast six times and six times the tortoise was ruined—did a spirit punish excess?
units.literal: Wang Ying's seal was cast six times and six times the tortoise was ruined—was it a spirit punishing fullness?

units.zh: 然億兆夷人，卒降十亂，紂之百克，終自無後，潁川之戰，即是殷監。
units.en: Yet when the hundred millions of the Yi people submitted, Zhou's ten capable ministers prevailed; King Zhou's hundred victories in the end left him without heirs—the battle at Yingchuan is the warning of Yin.
units.literal: Yet when the hundred millions of the Yi people submitted, the ten rebels of Zhou fell; Zhou's hundred victories in the end left him without heirs — the battle at Yingchuan is the warning of Yin.

units.zh: 時明帝謀入嗣位，朝之舊臣皆引參謀策。
units.en: Mingdi was then plotting to enter the succession; old courtiers were all drawn into counsel.
units.literal: Mingdi was then plotting succession to the throne; old ministers of the court were all drawn into counsel.

units.zh: 明帝下詔曰：「夫超然榮觀，風流自遠；
units.en: Mingdi issued an edict: "To stand beyond glory is to see the world from far off;
units.literal: Mingdi issued an edict: "One who stands apart from glory views the world from afar;

units.zh: 初，齊明帝及覽父綍、東海徐孝嗣，並爲吳興，號稱名守，覽皆欲過之！
units.en: Once Qi Mingdi, Lan's father Fu, and Donghai's Xu Xiaosi had all ruled Wuxing as famed administrators—Lan meant to outdo them all!
units.literal: Earlier Qi Mingdi, Lan's father Fu, and Xu Xiaosi of Donghai had all governed Wuxing and been called famed administrators—Lan wished to surpass them all!

units.zh: 建武四年，詔徵爲侍中、中書令，遂抗表不應召。
units.en: In Jianwu's fourth year an edict summoned him as attendant-in-ordinary and palace secretariat director; he memorialized and refused.
units.literal: In the fourth year of Jianwu an edict summoned him as Attendant-in-Ordinary and Palace Secretariat Director; he submitted a memorial refusing the summons.

units.zh: 蹈彼幽人，英華罕值。
units.en: to walk the hermit's way is to bloom in solitude.
units.literal: one who treads the hermit's path is rarely met in full flower.

units.zh: 故長揖楚相，見稱南國；
units.en: hence the long bow of the Chu minister won praise in the southern states;
units.literal: Hence the long bow to the Chu minister won praise in the southern states;

units.zh: 高謝漢臣，取貴良史。
units.en: the Han worthy's lofty refusal won honor from fine historians.
units.literal: the Han worthy's high refusal won honor from fine historians.

units.zh: 新除侍中、中書令朏，早藉羽儀，夙標清尚，登朝樹績，出守馳聲。
units.en: The newly appointed attendant-in-ordinary and palace secretariat director Fei long wore court insignia and from youth bore a clear name; in court he built merit, abroad he made his name heard.
units.literal: The newly appointed Attendant-in-Ordinary and Palace Secretariat Director Fei long bore the court insignia and from youth bore a pure reputation; in court he built merit, going out he made his name heard.

units.zh: 遂斂跡康衢，拂衣林沚，抱箕潁之餘芳，甘憔悴而無悶。
units.en: Then he gathered his steps from the broad highway and shook dust from forest robes, keeping the after-scent of Jiqian and Ying, glad in lean exile without regret.
units.literal: Then he gathered his steps from the broad highway and shook the dust from his forest robes, embracing the lingering fragrance of Jiqian and Ying, content in lean exile without regret.

units.zh: 撫事懷人，載留欽想。
units.en: Hearing his story, one keeps him in honored thought.
units.literal: Hearing of his deeds one keeps him in honored thought.

units.zh: 宜加優禮，用旌素概。
units.en: Let added courtesy mark his plain integrity.
units.literal: He should receive added courtesy to mark his plain integrity.

units.zh: 可賜床帳褥席，俸以卿祿，常出在所。」
units.en: Grant bed curtains and padded mats, salary at minister rank, always sent to his dwelling."
units.literal: Grant bed curtains and padded mats, salary at minister rank, always provided at his dwelling."

units.zh: 尚書敬顯儁曰：「孔子云：『微管仲，吾其被發左衽矣』以此言之，右衽為是。」
units.en: Minister Jing Xianjun said, "Confucius said, 'Were it not for Guan Zhong, we would wear our hair loose and our lapel to the left.' By this reasoning the right lapel is correct."
units.literal: Minister Jing Xianjun said, "Confucius said, 'Were it not for Guan Zhong, we would wear our hair loose and our lapel to the left.' By this reasoning the right lapel is correct."

units.zh: 十二月丙寅旦，珍國引稷於衛尉府，勒兵入自雲龍門，卽東昏於內殿斬之，與稷會尚書僕射王亮等於西鐘下，使中書舍人裴長穆等奉東昏首歸高祖。
units.en: On the morning of day bingyin in the twelfth month, Zhenguo led Ji to the Ministry of Guard headquarters, mustered troops through Cloud Dragon Gate, and at once beheaded Donghun in the inner hall; with Ji he met right vice director Wang Liang and others below the western bell and had palace scribe Pei Changmu and others present Donghun's head to Gaozu.
units.literal: On the morning of day bingyin in the twelfth month, Zhenguo led Ji to the Ministry of Guard headquarters, mustered troops entering by Cloud Dragon Gate, and at once beheaded Donghun in the inner hall; with Ji he met Right Vice Director Wang Liang and others below the western bell, and had Palace Scribe-in-Ordinary Pei Changmu and others present Donghun's head to Gaozu.

units.zh: 俄而荊州刺史沈攸之作亂，高帝謂淹曰：「天下紛紛若是，君謂何如？」
units.en: Soon Jing inspector Shen Youzhi rose in arms; Gaodi asked Yan, "The world is chaos like this—what is your view?"
units.literal: Before long Jing inspector Shen Youzhi rebelled; Gaodi said to Yan, "The realm is in such turmoil—what do you think?"

units.zh: 昇明初，齊帝輔政，聞其才，召爲尚書駕部郎、驃騎參軍事。
units.en: At the start of Ascendant Bright, with Qi's emperor as regent, he heard of Yan and made him secretariat director of the imperial equipage and valiant-cavalry staff officer.
units.literal: At the start of the Ascendant Bright era, when Qi's emperor held regency, he heard of Yan's talent and summoned him as Masters of Writing director of the imperial equipage and valiant-cavalry staff officer.

units.zh: 太祖高皇帝篤猶子之愛，降家人之慈；
units.en: Grand Ancestor Gao cherished a nephew as a son and gave the kindness of kin under one roof;
units.literal: Grand Ancestor Emperor Gao cherished the love due a nephew-son and granted the kindness shown within a household;

units.zh: 王珍國 馬仙琕 張齊
units.en: Wang Zhenguo; Ma Xianpin; Zhang Qi
units.literal: Wang Zhenguo; Ma Xianpin; Zhang Qi

units.zh: 時城中咸思從義，莫敢先發，侍中、衛尉張稷都督衆軍，珍國潛結稷腹心張齊要稷，稷許之。
units.en: Everyone in the city wished to turn to the righteous cause, yet none dared move first; attendant Zhang Ji as Ministry of Guard general commanded the host; Zhenguo secretly won over Ji's confidant Zhang Qi to sway Ji, and Ji agreed.
units.literal: At the time everyone in the city wished to follow righteousness, yet none dared act first; Attendant Zhang Ji as Ministry of Guard general commanded all troops; Zhenguo secretly joined with Ji's trusted man Zhang Qi to win Ji over, and Ji agreed.

units.zh: 張齊字子響，馮翊郡人。
units.en: Zhang Qi, styled Zixiang, was a man of Fengyi commandery.
units.literal: Zhang Qi, styled Zixiang, was a native of Fengyi commandery.

units.zh: 諡曰壯。
units.en: He was posthumously titled Zhuang (Stalwart).
units.literal: His posthumous title was Zhuang.

units.zh: 明年，高祖受禪，封齊安昌縣侯，邑五百戶，仍爲寧朔將軍、歷陽太守。
units.en: Next year Gaozu took the throne; Qi was made Marquis of Anchang with five hundred households, retaining pacification north general and Liyang administrator.
units.literal: The next year Gaozu received the abdication; Qi was enfeoffed as Marquis of Anchang county with a fief of five hundred households, and remained Pacification North General and Administrator of Liyang.

units.zh: 四年，魏將王足寇巴、蜀，高祖以齊爲輔國將軍救蜀。
units.en: In year four Wei general Wang Zu invaded Ba and Shu; Gaozu made Qi assists-the-state general to relieve Shu.
units.literal: In the fourth year, Wei general Wang Zu invaded Ba and Shu; Gaozu made Qi Assists-the-State General to rescue Shu.

units.zh: 稷爲南兗州，又擢爲府中兵參軍，始委以軍旅。
units.en: When Ji took South Yanzhou, Qi was promoted to military participation officer on the staff and first put in charge of troops.
units.literal: When Ji was made South Yanzhou inspector, Qi was also promoted to Military Participation Officer on the prefecture staff and for the first time was entrusted with military affairs.

units.zh: 齊手不知書，目不識字，而在郡有清政，吏事甚脩。
units.en: Qi could neither write nor read, yet in office he ruled cleanly and managed affairs diligently.
units.literal: Qi did not know writing by hand and could not read characters by sight, yet in his commandery he had pure governance and handled official business very well.

units.zh: 其年，遷武旅將軍、巴西太守，尋加征遠將軍。
units.en: That year he became martial array general and Baxi administrator, soon with added pacifies-the-distance general.
units.literal: That year he was transferred to Martial Array General and Administrator of Baxi, and soon was additionally made Pacifies-the-Distance General.

units.zh: 齊永元中，義師起，東昏徵稷歸，都督宮城諸軍事，居尚書省。
units.en: In Qi Yongyuan, the righteous army rose; Donghun recalled Ji, made him commander of palace-city forces, and lodged him in the Masters of Writing complex.
units.literal: In the Yongyuan era of Qi, the Righteous Army rose; Donghun summoned Ji back, made him Area Commander of all palace-city military affairs, and had him reside in the Masters of Writing complex.

units.zh: 明旦，與稷、珍國卽東昏於內殿，齊手刃焉。
units.en: At dawn he, Ji, and Zhenguo seized Donghun in the inner hall; Qi himself killed him with his blade.
units.literal: At dawn the next day, together with Ji and Zhenguo, he seized Donghun in the inner hall; Qi himself struck him dead with his blade.

units.zh: 天監二年，還爲虎賁中郎將。
units.en: In Tianjian year two he returned as tiger-fang central corps general.
units.literal: In the second year of Tianjian he was recalled and made Tiger-Fang Central Corps General.

units.zh: 七年秋，使齊置大劍、寒冢二戍，軍還益州。
units.en: In autumn of year seven he set garrisons at Dajian and Hanzong, then returned the army to Yizhou.
units.literal: In autumn of the seventh year Qi was ordered to set up two garrisons at Dajian and Hanzong; the army returned to Yizhou.

units.zh: 十年，郡人姚景和聚合蠻蜒，抄斷江路，攻破金井。
units.en: In year ten Yao Jinghe of the commandery rallied Man of Yan, cut the river route, and stormed Jinjing.
units.literal: In the tenth year, a man of the commandery, Yao Jinghe, gathered Man tribes of Yan and cut the river road, breaking Jinjing.

units.zh: 十一年，進假節、督益州外水諸軍。
units.en: In year eleven he gained acting credentials and command of Yizhou outer-water forces.
units.literal: In the eleventh year he was advanced to Acting Credentials and Area Commander of all Yizhou outer-water forces.

units.zh: 十二年，魏將傅豎眼寇南安，齊率衆距之，豎眼退走。
units.en: In year twelve Wei general Fu Shuyan attacked Nan'an; Qi resisted and Shuyan withdrew.
units.literal: In the twelfth year, Wei general Fu Shuyan invaded Nan'an; Qi led the host to resist him, and Shuyan withdrew.

units.zh: 十四年，遷信武將軍、巴西、梓潼二郡太守。
units.en: In year fourteen he became trusted martial general and administrator of Baxi and Zitong.
units.literal: In the fourteenth year he was transferred to Trusted Martial General and Administrator of the two commanderies Baxi and Zitong.

units.zh: 十五年，魏東益州刺史元法僧遣子景隆來拒齊師，南安太守皇甫諶及宗範逆擊之，大破魏軍於葭萌，屠十餘城，魏將丘突、王穆等皆降。
units.en: In year fifteen Wei east Yizhou inspector Yuan Faseng sent his son Jinglong against Qi; Nan'an administrator Huangfu Chen and Zongfan counterattacked, crushing the Wei army at Jiameng, sacking more than ten cities; Wei generals Qiu Tu and Wang Mu among others surrendered.
units.literal: In the fifteenth year, Wei East Yizhou Inspector Yuan Faseng sent his son Jinglong to resist Qi's army; Nan'an Administrator Huangfu Chen and Zongfan counterattacked, smashing the Wei host at Jiameng, slaughtering more than ten cities; Wei generals Qiu Tu, Wang Mu, and others all surrendered.

units.zh: 十七年，遷持節、都督南梁州諸軍事、智武將軍、南梁州刺史。
units.en: In year seventeen he became bearer of credentials, area commander of South Liang, sagacious martial general, and South Liang inspector.
units.literal: In the seventeenth year he was transferred to Bearer of Credentials, Area Commander of all South Liangzhou military affairs, Sagacious Martial General, and South Liangzhou Inspector.

units.zh: 普通四年，遷信武將軍、征西鄱陽王司馬、新興、永寧二郡太守。
units.en: In Putong year four he became trusted martial general, western campaign staff officer to the prince of Poyang, and administrator of Xinxing and Yongning.
units.literal: In the fourth year of Putong he was transferred to Trusted Martial General, Chief Clerk to the Prince of Poyang in the Western Campaign, and Administrator of the two commanderies Xinxing and Yongning.

units.zh: 未發而卒，時年六十七。
units.en: Before departing he died, aged sixty-seven.
units.literal: Before he set out he died, aged sixty-seven.

units.zh: 世居橫桑，或云橫桑人也。
units.en: His family had long lived at Hengsang; some say he was native there.
units.literal: His family had long dwelt at Hengsang; some say he was a man of Hengsang.

units.zh: 歷生罷官歸，吳郡張稷爲荊府司馬，齊復從之，稷甚相知重，以爲心腹，雖家居細事，皆以任焉。
units.en: When Lisheng left office, Zhang Ji of Wu became Jing chief of staff; Qi followed him again. Ji deeply trusted him as a confidant and even entrusted household matters to him.
units.literal: When Lisheng left office and returned home, Zhang Ji of Wu commandery became Jing prefecture Chief of Staff; Qi again followed him. Ji knew and valued him deeply, taking him as a trusted confidant—even household trifles were all entrusted to him.

units.zh: 少有膽氣。
units.en: From youth he had courage and spirit.
units.literal: From youth he had daring and spirit.

units.zh: 初事荊府司馬垣歷生。
units.en: He first served Jing prefecture chief of staff Yuan Lisheng.
units.literal: At first he served Jing prefecture Chief of Staff Yuan Lisheng.

units.zh: 義兵至，周邊漸急，齊日造王珍國，陰與定計。
units.en: As the righteous army drew near and the ring tightened, Qi visited Wang Zhenguo daily and secretly fixed their plan.
units.literal: When the righteous army arrived, the siege around them grew pressing; Qi went daily to Wang Zhenguo and secretly settled plans with him.

units.zh: 計定，夜引珍國就稷造膝，齊自執燭以成謀。
units.en: When the plan was set, at night he brought Zhenguo to Ji for a knee-to-knee counsel; Qi himself held the candle while they plotted.
units.literal: Once the plan was set, at night he led Zhenguo to Ji to join in deliberation knee to knee; Qi himself held the candle to complete the plot.

units.zh: 未至，足退走，齊進戍南安。
units.en: Before he arrived Zu had withdrawn; Qi advanced to hold Nan'an.
units.literal: Before he arrived, Zu withdrew; Qi advanced to garrison Nan'an.

units.zh: 齊討景和於平昌，破之。
units.en: Qi attacked Jinghe at Pingchang and broke him.
units.literal: Qi attacked Jinghe at Pingchang and defeated him.

units.zh: 齊上夷獠義租，得米二十萬斛。
units.en: Qi reported righteous tribute from the Yi and Liao, gaining two hundred thousand hu of rice.
units.literal: Qi reported righteous tribute levies from Yi and Liao, obtaining two hundred thousand hu of rice.

units.zh: 又立臺傳，興冶鑄，以應贍南梁。
units.en: He also set relays and opened foundries to sustain South Liang.
units.literal: He also set up relay stations and opened smelting and casting to supply South Liang.

units.zh: 而魏更增傅豎眼兵，復來拒戰，齊兵少不利，軍引還，於是葭萌復沒於魏。
units.en: Wei reinforced Fu Shuyan and fought again; with too few men Qi fared ill and withdrew, and Jiameng fell back to Wei.
units.literal: But Wei increased Fu Shuyan's troops and came again to resist; Qi's army was few and met with ill fortune, the army drew back, and so Jiameng again fell to Wei.

units.zh: 其居軍中，能身親勞辱，與士卒同其勤苦。
units.en: In camp he shared labor and hardship with the troops.
units.literal: When he dwelt in the army he could personally share toil and hardship and suffer the same labor and pain as the soldiers.

units.zh: 自畫頓舍城壘，皆委曲得其便，調給衣糧資用，人人無所困乏。
units.en: He sketched encampments and walls to suit every need and rationed clothing and grain so none wanted for anything.
units.literal: He himself drew the plans for encampments and fortifications, all laid out for convenience in detail; he allocated clothing, grain, and supplies so that no man lacked what he needed.

units.zh: 齊沿路聚糧食，種蔬菜，行者皆取給焉。
units.en: Along the route Qi stockpiled grain and planted vegetables so travelers could be supplied.
units.literal: Along the road Qi gathered food stores and planted vegetables; all travelers could draw their needs there.

units.zh: 旣爲物情所附，蠻獠亦不敢犯，是以威名行於庸、蜀。
units.en: Men attached to him and even Man and Liao dared not offend him; his fame ran through Yong and Shu.
units.literal: Once he had won men's hearts, even Man and Liao did not dare offend him; thus his martial renown spread through Yong and Shu.

units.zh: 追贈散騎常侍、右衛將軍。
units.en: Posthumously he was made regular attendant cavalier attendant-in-ordinary and right palace guard general.
units.literal: Posthumously he was made Regular Attendant Cavalier Attendant-in-Ordinary and Right Palace Guard General.

units.zh: 賻錢十萬，布百匹。
units.en: Funeral bounty was one hundred thousand cash and one hundred bolts of cloth.
units.literal: Funeral bounty: one hundred thousand cash and one hundred bolts of cloth.

units.zh: 歷生酗酒，遇下嚴酷，不甚禮之。
units.en: Lisheng drank heavily and was harsh to subordinates; he showed Qi little courtesy.
units.literal: Lisheng was given to drink; he was harsh toward subordinates and did not treat Qi with much courtesy.

units.zh: 齊盡心事稷，無所辭憚。
units.en: Qi served Ji wholeheartedly and shrank from nothing.
units.literal: Qi served Ji with his whole heart and shirked nothing.

units.zh: 益州刺史鄱陽王遣齊帥衆三萬，督南梁州長史席宗範諸軍迎令宗。
units.en: The prince of Poyang as Yizhou inspector sent Qi with thirty thousand men, overseeing chief clerk Xi Zongfan and others to welcome Lingzong.
units.literal: Yizhou Inspector the Prince of Poyang sent Qi to command thirty thousand men, supervising South Liang Chief Clerk Xi Zongfan and all armies to welcome Lingzong.

units.zh: 齊在益部累年，討擊蠻獠，身無寧歲。
units.en: Qi spent years in the Yi lands campaigning against Man and Liao; he had no peaceful year.
units.literal: Qi spent years in the Yi region, attacking and striking Man and Liao; he himself had no peaceful year.

units.zh: 張齊之政績，亦有異焉。
units.en: Zhang Qi's achievements in office were distinctive as well.
units.literal: Zhang Qi's administrative achievements also had their differences.

units.zh: 高祖卽位，緭頻造尚書范雲，雲不好緭，堅距之。
units.en: After Gaozu took the throne Wei often visited Fan Yun, minister of personnel; Yun disliked him and kept him out.
units.literal: After Gaozu took the throne Wei often called on the Minister of Personnel Fan Yun; Yun disliked him and firmly shut him out.

units.zh: 時明帝諸子幼弱，內親則仗遙欣兄弟，外親則倚后弟劉暄、內弟江祏。
units.en: The Ming Emperor's sons were still young; inside the palace he leaned on the Yaoqin brothers, outside on the empress's brother Liu Xuan and her brother-in-law Jiang Shi.
units.literal: At that time the Ming Emperor's sons were young and weak; for kin within the palace he relied on the Yaoqin brothers, for kin without on the empress's brother Liu Xuan and her brother-in-law Jiang Shi.

units.zh: 四年，太尉陳顯達督衆軍北圍馬圈，景宗從之，以甲士二千設伏，破魏援托跋英四萬人。
units.en: In year four Grand Commandant Chen Xianda besieged Maquan in the north; Jingzong followed with two thousand armored men in ambush and routed forty thousand Wei troops under Tuoba Ying.
units.literal: In the fourth year Grand Commandant Chen Xianda commanded the armies north to besiege Maquan; Jingzong followed him and, with two thousand armored men, set an ambush and defeated Wei relief under Tuoba Ying—forty thousand men.

units.zh: 及剋馬圈，顯達論功，以景宗爲後，景宗退無怨言。
units.en: When Maquan fell, Xianda ranked the merit and put Jingzong last; Jingzong withdrew without a word.
units.literal: When Maquan was taken, Xianda assessed merit and ranked Jingzong last; Jingzong withdrew without complaint.

units.zh: 魏主率衆大至，顯達宵奔，景宗導入山道，故顯達父子獲全。
units.en: The Wei ruler came in force; Xianda fled by night, and Jingzong led him through the mountains, so Xianda and his son escaped whole.
units.literal: The Wei ruler led a great army up; Xianda fled by night, and Jingzong guided him into mountain paths—therefore Xianda and his son were wholly saved.

units.zh: 遙光敗，入東昏宮。
units.en: When Yaoguang fell, she was taken into the Depraved Emperor's palace.
units.literal: When Yaoguang was defeated, she entered the Depraved Emperor's palace.

units.zh: 杲少好學，工書畫，舅張融有高名，杲風韻舉動，頗類於融，時稱之曰：「無對日下，惟舅與甥。」
units.en: Gao loved learning from youth and was skilled at calligraphy and painting. His maternal uncle Zhang Rong had a great reputation, and Gao's style, bearing, and movements much resembled Rong, so people of the time said, "There are no equals under the sun, only uncle and nephew."
units.literal: Gao loved learning from youth and was skilled at calligraphy and painting. His maternal uncle Zhang Rong had a great reputation, and Gao's style, bearing, and movements much resembled Rong, so people of the time said, "There are no equals under the sun, only uncle and nephew."

units.zh: 陳郡袁昂領丹陽尹，辟為主簿，人務事宜，皆被顧訪。
units.en: Chen commandery Yuan Ang held Danyang prefect; he recruited Zhicai as chief clerk, and whenever men had business affairs they were all referred to him for counsel.
units.literal: Chen commandery Yuan Ang held Danyang prefect; he recruited Zhicai as chief clerk, and whenever men had business affairs they were all referred to him for counsel.

units.zh: 郡廨遭火，之才起望，夜中不著衣，披紅服帕出房，映光為昂所見。
units.en: The prefectural offices suffered fire; Zhicai rose to look and in the night wore no clothes, but came out of the room in a red kerchief over his shoulders; the light caught him and Ang saw it.
units.literal: The prefectural offices suffered fire; Zhicai rose to look and in the night wore no clothes, but came out of the room in a red kerchief over his shoulders; the light caught him and Ang saw it.

units.zh: 功曹白請免職，昂重其才術，仍特原之。
units.en: The merit officer memorialized asking that he be dismissed; Ang valued his talent and skill and specially pardoned him.
units.literal: The merit officer memorialized asking that he be dismissed; Ang valued his talent and skill and specially pardoned him.

units.zh: 外從祖宋右光祿張永嘗攜內外孫侄游虎丘山，協年數歲，永撫之曰：「兒欲何戲？」
units.en: His maternal great-uncle Zhang Yong, who had served Song as Right Director of the Imperial Secretariat, once took the inner and outer grandsons and nephews to tour Tiger Hill. Xie was only a few years old; Yong stroked him and said, "Child, what would you like to play?"
units.literal: His maternal great-uncle Zhang Yong, Right Director of the Imperial Secretariat of Song, once took the inner and outer grandsons and nephews to tour Tiger Hill. Xie was only a few years old; Yong stroked him and said, "Child, what game do you wish to play?"

units.zh: 永歎息曰：「顧氏興於此子。」
units.en: Yong sighed and said, "The Gu clan will rise through this child."
units.literal: Yong sighed and said, "The Gu clan will rise through this child."

units.zh: 頃之，又副領軍王瑩。
units.en: Soon afterward he again served as deputy to Wang Ying, Commander of the Army.
units.literal: Soon afterward he again served as deputy to Wang Ying, Commander of the Army.
